result.response:
The requirement in `summary.txt` specifies that `Frequency.getPct(Object)` must return the percentage of occurrences equal to the specified value rather than the cumulative percentage.

### Root Cause
In `org.apache.commons.math.stat.Frequency`, the deprecated overload `getPct(Object v)` erroneously invoked `getCumPct((Comparable<?>) v)` instead of delegating to `getPct((Comparable<?>) v)`.

### Fix
In [`Frequency.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_75_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/stat/Frequency.java#L302-L304), modified `getPct(Object v)` to call `getPct((Comparable<?>) v)`.

### Verification
Ran `org.apache.commons.math.stat.FrequencyTest` which includes `testPcts`, and all tests passed. Generated the patch file [`nl_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_75_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
